preprocessor.input: ordered precedence-bound lineage JSONL with file and per-record content hashes
preprocessor.near_dedup: disk-backed SQLite MinHash band candidates followed by exact token-shingle Jaccard verification
preprocessor.removal_records: content hashes, reason, source/line, retained owner, and verified similarity; no removed text
preprocessor.resume: record checkpoints bind output byte slices and a SQLite accepted-document hash chain; divergence is rolled back or rejected
preprocessor.index: retained SQLite database with file hash, integrity check, document and band counts

cleanup.order: verify cleanup file hashes before processing; publish and fsync manifest; remove exact allowlist; write cleanup receipt
cleanup.recovery: published output without a cleanup receipt resumes only the declared idempotent cleanup step

existing_qualified_features: committed shard, index, and journal checksum recovery
required_order: firewall construction from separately declared eligible source data

must_measure: SQLite index bytes and peak memory
exact, candidate, verified-near, deny-ledger, and retained counts
interruption recovery before, during, and after checkpoints and source publication
raw cleanup and post-publication cleanup recovery
unique-token yield and projected full-corpus capacity
must_verify: source, ledger, implementation, tokenizer, output, index, and cleanup hashes
no removed text in removal records
restarted output identity equals uninterrupted output identity
firewall and model-training data are disjoint

production_authority_record.status: must not be issued from fixture evidence
